t: Forge Steel 50m fibreglass surveyors tape measure is an essential tool for accurate long-distance measurements across various building and landscaping projects. Housed in a durable ABS plastic case to protect the PVC-coated fibreglass blade, ensuring resistance to abrasion and corrosion for prolonged site use. The manual tape features clear metric and imperial scales, providing versatile measuring options, whilst the integrated ground spike hook allows for secure, single-person operation. Ideal for large area layouts and construction tasks. Includes double-sided markings, improving visibility and efficiency during routine daily measurements.
